issues.spec_citation: CQL Reference v1.5.3 Clinical Operators: ExpandValueSet(ValueSet); ValueSet references may carry a version and membership boundaries use the canonical id|version reference.
issues.evidence: Versioned ValueSet literal translated to ExpandValueSet({id, version}), but macro looked up only $.id in valueset_codes. With only valueset_url url|2026 loaded, Count(ExpandValueSet(Vitals)) returned NULL while HR in Vitals returned TRUE.
issues.root_cause: The Python-registered and SQL-only ExpandValueSet macros ignored the structured ValueSet version field, unlike ValueSet membership unwrapping which preserves id|version.
issues.resolution: Updated both ExpandValueSet macro registrations to derive id|version when a structured ValueSet JSON argument contains version; added versioned expansion and membership parity tests across Python fallback, native-loaded, and no-Python runtimes.
